newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks led lower by banks, supermarkets.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks led lower by banks, supermarkets.

text.p: Colombian stocks continued downward for the fifth straight session, pulled down by banks and supermarkets, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB index fell 0.55 percent to 1,191.74 amid a 2.7 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED general price index dipped 0.4 percent to 18,127.44. The trading volume in Medellin was unavailable.
"The markets are a bit sluggish and there don't seem to be any big investors out there. Those that are buying are looking to purchase below market price," one Bogota broker said.
